* A custom version of {@code android.util.SparseArray} with the minimal API * for storing {@link FieldData} objects. * *

This class is an internal implementation detail of nano and should not * be called directly by clients. * * Based on {@code android.support.v4.util.SpareArrayCompat}.

methods.name: FieldData get(int fieldNumber)
methods.comment: * Gets the FieldData mapped from the specified fieldNumber, or null * if no such mapping has been made.

methods.name: void remove(int fieldNumber)
methods.comment: * Removes the data from the specified fieldNumber, if there was any.

methods.name: void put(int fieldNumber, FieldData data)
methods.comment:
* Adds a mapping from the specified fieldNumber to the specified data,
     * replacing the previous mapping if there was one.

methods.name: int size()
methods.comment:
* Returns the number of key-value mappings that this FieldArray
     * currently stores.

methods.name: FieldData dataAt(int index)
methods.comment: * Given an index in the range 0...size()-1, returns * the value from the indexth key-value mapping that this * FieldArray stores.

methods.name: private boolean arrayEquals(int[] a, int[] b, int size)
private boolean arrayEquals(FieldData[] a, FieldData[] b, int size)

methodNames: private boolean arrayEquals(int[] a, int[] b, int size)
